# v0.9.0b2 — Charging jobs in the app, all phase values on Total power

Update the app to **0.9.0b2** together with the integration.

- **Breaking: BavarianData 0.9.30 or newer** is required for automatic vehicle
  selection and Virtual Plug & Charge. Its dated **Charging Cable** sensor is
  the only cable source now.
- **Breaking: no automatic cleanup** of the entities folded in 0.9.0b1; delete
  leftover entries in the entity list.
- **Breaking: all phase values on Total power.** While power flows it carries
  the current, voltage and power of L1 to L3 as attributes; the three
  **Current L1–L3** sensors are gone.
- **Breaking: Switch off charging release when unplugged** starts switched off
  once; switch it on again after the update.
- **Breaking: the "Recover from a lost heartbeat" blueprint is gone.** Recovery
  is built in; delete automations made from it.
- **App: charging jobs, boost, guest charging and weekly plans.** The app runs
  an energy and time order for the plugged-in car on its own, estimates when it
  finishes, can charge early or an immediate reserve before the planned start,
  repeats orders from a weekly plan for up to seven days, and gives a locally
  authorized guest a bounded order. None of them grants a release or unlocks the wallbox. Once an
  order ends and its pause is confirmed, Home Assistant controls charging
  again, also between weekly departures. An order continues after an app
  restart only when the wallbox proves the car stayed plugged in. A weekly
  plan activated for a car that Home Assistant had confirmed activates itself
  whenever Home Assistant confirms that car again.
- **App: new pages.** **Open Web UI** starts on an overview of the wallbox and
  the last commands; connection settings moved to **Connection**, and new
  pages show the raw registers and apply poll intervals, the current cap and
  the waits between charging changes without a restart.
  Every page is available in all five languages.
  See [the app's web pages](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/docs/app-guide.md).
- **Departure planning runs in the app.** With the Modbus service app, Home
  Assistant hands over the departure, the car and its charge levels, and the
  app plans by itself, also while Home Assistant is offline. Between the car's
  reports it projects the charge level from the metered energy.
  See [departure planning](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/docs/departure-planning.md#with-the-modbus-service-app).
- **Minimum charge level.** Departure planning can charge the car at once up
  to a percentage you choose and only then wait for the planned start.
  See [departure planning](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/docs/departure-planning.md#minimum-charge-level).
- **Departure planning** finishes closer to the departure time and handles the
  exact 6 A boundary; **Plug & Charge** explains why it waits or blocks.
- Many fixes from code reviews, among them: one lost reply no longer marks the
  wallbox as disconnected, a car switch ends the previous car's plan pause, and
  a selected car must confirm the plug-in before its rules apply.

[Changelog](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/CHANGELOG.md)
